notes: Money-write flag (2026-10-31, security audit 2026-10-29 finding 14, step 1 of 2; owner decision 2026-10-31 (a)): the invoice, billing-settings, billing-engine, collection v2, wallet and Moov parity write paths set the server-only transaction-local GUC request.money_write = 1 (SELECT set_config(...,true)) in their open transaction before they write the money tables, through the added money-write-flag.mjs. No policy reads it yet: behavior-neutral. SQL 136 (step 2) restricts the money tables to it (and the SQL 72 / SQL 91 GUCs) and must not be applied before every member here is live in staging and production. The generic /data/write route never sets it. No SQL; no money movement; no export changes. live_sha256 is each row's previous accepted bytes (main's bytes, put live by the third full-package production rebuild, run 39669873076, or a later recorded overlay); a read-only production overlay inspect must confirm each live member before any apply. money-write-flag.mjs is new, so it has no live bytes; moov-wallet-sync.mjs (the first importer in plan order) and every other member import it at load, so it is ordered first.
